obsoleteReferenceResolution.questionText:
Write a piece of continuous prose in Russian (140
words) in answer to ONE of the following. In your
answer make sure to include ALL the points listed.

You may use vocabulary and turns of phrase from
texts in other sections of the examination paper,
but marks will not be awarded for segments of
your essay which replicate word for word
segments from examination texts.

1. LETTER
It has been three years since your school
graduation. You want to organise a get-together to
mark the occasion. Write a letter to your
classmates. In your letter include the following:

• Who will be there
• What you will be doing
• Where the event will take place
•  Briefly describe the menu for the evening
• What type of music you will have

OR

Write a letter to your friend’s parents trying to
convince them to let their son/daughter spend two
weeks with you in Ireland. In your letter make
reference to:
   •   Suitable dates for travel
   •  Ways to get to Ireland
   •  Things to bring with him / her
   •  What you will be doing
   •  Where you will be staying

2. NARRATIVE

(a) Write about the best memory from your
    winter holidays.

OR

(b) Write a review of a concert/festival that you
    recently attended.

3. DISCUSSION

(a) Discuss the difficulty of a career choice for
   young people today.

OR

(b) Discuss the challenges that gifted children face
    in life.

No verified playback copy of the SEC recording is bound to this deck, so the card would be unanswerable from what it shows.
